_comment: Producer-signature CROSS-LANGUAGE byte-compat vector for a macOS Swift flow_decision_recorded body (C2). The canonical body and signature were emitted by castle-wall-macos AuditProducerChain.buildSignedFlowDecision using CryptoKit Curve25519.Signing over AuditProducerSigningConstants.domainPrefix + canonical + captured_at_unix_ms + seq. TypeScript loads this fixture through audit-consumer-chain-basis.test.ts and must verify/chains over the exact Swift-emitted canonical string. The Swift test regenerates the same body from the deterministic seed and fails if its emitter drifts. The keypair is deterministic test material, not a production key.
